title: Worked example · Stationary ordered sweeps need not be reversible
source_anchor: Original ASTIS four-state witness; He–De Sa–Mitliagkas–Ré v1 §5 (PDF p. 6), Chen–Štefankovič–Vigoda v4 §1.3 (PDF p. 5), background only
target_statement: On the four Boolean pairs, give the equal-bit points mass 3/8 each and the unequal-bit points mass 1/8 each. This is a full-support probability with both marginals uniform. The two displayed Markov kernels are the actual conditional refreshes of the first and second bit respectively. Each is reversible for that same law. The full sweep that performs the first-bit refresh before the second preserves the law but is not reversible.
